newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sales of unit trust savings plans soaring in H.K..
newsitem.headline: Sales of unit trust savings plans soaring in H.K..

text.p: Sales of unit trusts in Hong Kong through savings plans has almost doubled in the past three years, according to a selection of Hong Kong-based fund management companies.

"For most fund houses, savings plans have only been launched or been actively promoted in the past three to five years," Lin Yoke Seetoh, chairman of the Hong Kong Investment Funds Association unit trust sub-committee, said on Monday.
"Though they probably account for one to two percent of each company's sales, they have witnessed substantial growth in the past three years," she said.
An increased commitment by more fund companies to tap the local retail market and to offer services that catering to the general public is probably behind the improved popularity, she said.
The investment funds association is organizing a savings plan seminar and exhibition in October.
